headline: FASTag Annual Pass Sets Record: Crosses 1 Crore Users in One Year; Know Its Benefits
summary: The FASTag Annual Pass, launched in August 2025, has crossed more than 1 crore users across India within one year. The pass is aimed at private vehicle owners using national highways and expressways.
why: FASTag is India's electronic toll collection system run through national payment infrastructure, so usage trends affect toll revenue and highway operators. Adoption figures indicate how digital payment schemes are spreading.
